ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  ACME Solar Holdings Limited, via its wholly-owned subsidiary, has executed a significant 25-year Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) with the Solar Energy Corporation of India Limited (SECI) for a 300 MW assured Peak Power project, commencing April 2028 at a fixed tariff of Rs. 6.00 per unit. This substantial domestic contract is expected to provide stable, long-term revenue streams and significantly strengthen the company's market position in the renewable energy sector, with no red flags or related-party concerns identified.
